title: Smoky Algerian Chickpea Tagine
description: A hearty North African stew made with smoky spices, chickpeas, and a blend of aromatic herbs.

ingredients.name: algerian
ingredients.notes: a blend of paprika, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, algerian spice blend, smoky paprika, and lively ginger.
Stir to combine, then add 1 cup of water.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the flavors have melded together and the chickpeas are tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cilantro, and lemon juice.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro, if desired.
